 Learn more ISSAQUAH, Wash., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Costco Wholesale Corporation ("Costco" or the "Company") (Nasdaq: COST) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a special cash dividend of $30 per share on Costco common stock. It is payable December 4, 2026, to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 24, 2026. The total amount of the payment will be approximately $13.3 billion. 
 The Company also announced that the Board has reauthorized a common-stock repurchase program of up to $4 billion. This program will expire in November 2030 and replaces the current $4 billion program (adopted in 2023 and scheduled to expire January 2027), under which $3.1 billion had been purchased. 
 Costco currently operates 945 warehouses, including 653 in the United States and Puerto Rico, 115 in Canada, 43 in Mexico, 37 in Japan, 29 in the United Kingdom, 20 in Korea, 15 in Australia, 14 in Taiwan, seven in China, five in Spain, three in France, two in Sweden, and one each in Iceland, and New Zealand. Costco also operates e-commerce sites in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Mexico, Korea, Taiwan, Japan, Australia, and China.
